Its siblings in this file, `one_le_tprod` (`tsum_nonneg`) and `tprod_le_one`, carry no `NeBot` assumption and handle the `⊥` case, and the extra instance would also have to be synthesized by any automation (e.g. a positivity extension) that uses the lemma.

Drop `[L.NeBot]` from `tprod_nonneg` and treat the trivial-filter case as `tprod_le_one` does, e.g.
```
theorem tprod_nonneg [CommMonoidWithZero α] [TopologicalSpace α] [Preorder α] [ZeroLEOneClass α]
    [PosMulMono α] [ClosedIciTopology α] {f : ι → α} (hf : ∀ i, 0 ≤ f i) :
    0 ≤ ∏'[L] i, f i := by
  by_cases h : Multipliable f L
  · by_cases hL : L.NeBot
    · exact le_hasProd_of_le_prod h.hasProd fun _ ↦ prod_nonneg fun i _ ↦ hf i
    · rw [tprod_bot hL]
      exact finprod_induction (0 ≤ ·) zero_le_one (fun _ _ ↦ mul_nonneg) hf
  · simp [tprod_eq_one_of_not_multipliable h]
```
(also using the bound variable `i`, as the hypothesis and the siblings do).
